strips.title: A dead battery at 6 a.m. in January — in real life

panels.head: 6:00 — click, click
panels.text: The cold cut the battery's output. No dome light, no start.

panels.head: 6:03 — clamps on
panels.text: Red to positive, black to bare metal, press power. Most engines start at once, per the maker's manual.

panels.head: 6:10 — let it run
panels.text: Drive to recharge the car battery. Then charge the pack at home.

panels.head: Next month — top up
panels.text: Cold drains a jump pack too. Check its charge every month or two.
